data.title: Walk through an existing room in VR
data.summary: One reviewed room, two controller inputs and an XR-capable device. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Three.js documents enabling a WebXR VR rendering session.

prerequisites: An authorized Three.js / WebXR environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: One reviewed room, two controller inputs and an XR-capable device.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent vr room workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: One reviewed room, two controller inputs and an XR-capable device. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Reuse the room's loader and enable the renderer's supported XR session path
Define a bounded locomotion mode and inspect floor scale before entering the headset
Test entry, recenter, exit and a non-XR fallback on the physical device

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned walk through an existing room in vr candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Session exit returns to an operable page
The room scale and floor height match the intended user reference
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Comfort, accessibility and controller mappings require device/user testing.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Start with stationary viewing before adding locomotion.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me walk through an existing room in vr in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: One reviewed room, two controller inputs and an XR-capable device. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Session exit returns to an operable page; The room scale and floor height match the intended user reference. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
